inspection_summary: Inspected all 3,540 lines. The paper builds a reusable chain from Jensen convexity through value distributions and derivative-weighted densities to mean motions and stripwise zero frequencies, extends that chain from ordinary to Besicovitch-type generalized almost periodic functions and their logarithms, then realizes zeta and log-zeta distributions as limits of prime-phase torus models whose Fourier transforms control smoothness, positivity, analyticity, and boundary behavior.
